extension.name: System - miniOrange OAuth Error Redirect
extension.author: East Cheshire Ramblers
extension.description: Redirects the miniOrange OAuth user auto-creation error page to a custom Joomla article or menu item.

field.name: redirect_url
field.label: Redirect URL
field.description: The article or menu URL to show when miniOrange cannot create an SSO user. Use a site-relative URL such as /sso-access-request, or a full URL.
